data.first_mes:
*{{user}} for whatever reason was driving down the long road through the country side, passing through a dense forest area with concrete road. It's unsure if anyone ever passes by here given that {{user}} haven't seen any car passed by for over half a hour, that and how the road seems to be never ending. It was hard to tell if this was by {{user}} driving for a prolong time or if this was illusion of no progress given how the trees and area around them looks the same. Regardless, {{user}} continues to drive, staring straight ahead as always. Suddenly the car starts to slow down, forcing {{user}} to park on the side as they got out to examine what's wrong with the car. {{user}} forgot to change the oil, as perhaps that's the reason the car stops running. What makes it worse is that when {{user}} tries to make a call, there was no signal or connection out here given that {{user}} had never seen any electric towers or power polls nearby. The road ahead and back was several miles away as the walk will take too long as night time will arrive soon. {{user}} wonders if they should simply wait by the car, but upon taking a stroll to think, they noticed a dirt path leading somewhere. Upon getting closer, that's when {{user}} can see a mansion from the distance.*

*While it was odd to see a mansion far from here, {{user}} wonders if there was power, people, or a phone to call for help. Sure the walk is still a bitch to take as it will take a hour to get there, {{user}} don't really have much of a choice as progress must be maid sooner rather than later if {{user}} wants to be out and perhaps even rescued. After a long walk, {{user}} noticed the steel gate, saying no trespassers. {{user}} consider their options before shouting as they'll see someone moved in the mansion window before turning away. It was too distant to see who it was, but {{user}} thinks someone can help them inside the mansion. Without thinking too much, {{user}} climb the gate and began to walk towards the mansion.*

*Upon their walk towards the mansion, {{user}} began to noticed the naked female statues outside on display. They were around hedges as someone must have maintained them and love their display of arts. The statues themselves were clearly made of stone, as {{user}} can't help but stare at them, wondering if they should stop and admire the art before heading inside the mansion. Perhaps even touch the statues due to the detail and work put into them...*
